rules.text: ▪ Apply Sika® Igolflex P-10+ primer at a rate of 6-8m2 per litre
rules.heading: PRIMING

rules.text: IMPORTANT ▪ At low temperatures, take care unrolling to avoid damaging the membrane. ▪In cold weather, it is preferable to warm up the surface and the tape to at least 15°C before application. ▪ Use suitable footwear to avoid puncturing the membrane. ▪ Do not apply to wet, damp or unclean surfaces. ▪ After unwinding the tape to the length required, peel back 5-10cm of the release liner, applying firm pressure on the membrane to ensure full bond is achieved to the substrate. ▪ Apply tape uniformly to avoid trapped air, which would lead to air bubbles being formed ▪ Use a small, hard roller to seal all overlaps and to form a fully bonded seal
rules.heading: APPLICATION
